label: Order
caption: Order of the Court
text: Supreme Court of the United States No. 22A29 (20-1375) KRISTINA BOX, ET AL., Applicants v. PLANNED PARENTHOOD OF IN & KY UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants and the response filed thereto, IT IS ORDERED that the application to issue the judgment forthwith to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit is granted. /s/ John G. Roberts, Jr. Chief Justice of the United States Dated this 18th day of July, 2022.
